description: Replace all remaining emoji characters in member-facing pages with Lucide React icons. Affected files: client/src/pages/member/Notifications.jsx (typeIcon map uses emoji strings + empty-state 🔔) and client/src/pages/public/Landing.jsx (steps[] and benefits[] arrays use emoji icon strings). Navbar.jsx, AppLayout.jsx, Sidebar.jsx, and MobileMenu.jsx already use Lucide icons exclusively — no changes needed there.
steps:
Edit client/src/pages/member/Notifications.jsx: import { DollarSign, XCircle, Clock, CheckCircle, CornerUpLeft, Info, Bell } from 'lucide-react'. Replace the typeIcon string map with a typeIconMap that maps each type to a Lucide component. In the notification list item, render the icon as instead of the emoji span. Replace the empty-state emoji

🔔

with .

Edit client/src/pages/public/Landing.jsx: import { PenLine, Coins, ClipboardList, Banknote, Lock, BarChart2, Lightbulb } from 'lucide-react'. Update the steps[] array: replace each emoji string icon with the correct Lucide component reference (PenLine for ✍️, Coins for 💰, ClipboardList for 📋, Banknote for 💸). Update the benefits[] array: replace each emoji string icon with the correct Lucide component (Lock for 🔒, BarChart2 for 📊, Lightbulb for 💡). In the JSX for both the How It Works and Benefits sections, change
{step.icon}
to — the data array field must be named Icon (capital I) so it is treated as a component. Update type declarations accordingly.
acceptance_criteria: No emoji characters (Unicode range U+1F300 and above) appear in Notifications.jsx or Landing.jsx
All notification type icons render as Lucide SVG components, not as text/emoji spans
The empty-state in Notifications.jsx shows a Bell icon instead of a 🔔 emoji
The How It Works and Benefits sections on Landing.jsx show Lucide icon components instead of emoji text
Running `npm run build` from client/ exits 0 with no errors
verification: cd client && npm run build — must exit 0 with no import or JSX errors

Grep for emoji patterns to confirm none remain: grep -rn --include='*.jsx' '[\x{1F300}-\x{1FFFF}]' client/src/pages/member/Notifications.jsx client/src/pages/public/Landing.jsx — should return no matches
findings: All emoji replaced with Lucide icons. Notifications.jsx: typeIconMap with DollarSign/XCircle/Clock/CheckCircle/CornerUpLeft/Info; empty-state uses Bell. Landing.jsx: steps[] and benefits[] use PenLine/Coins/ClipboardList/Banknote/Lock/BarChart2/Lightbulb as Icon components. Build exits 0.
